scope.audience: Adults who play daily word puzzles on iPhone (assumption from orchestrator facts; owner away)
scope.primary_goal: Understand the game and remember it for launch; no App Store link exists yet (assumption from orchestrator facts)
limitations: No field data (CrUX/RUM); performance numbers are one unthrottled lab run from this machine
No screen reader run; keyboard order checked by scripted Tab presses in headless Chrome only
Screenshots cover 390px and 1280px widths only; other widths checked by DOM metrics, not images
Not device testing: viewport emulation in headless google-chrome on Linux, which lacks Instrument Sans/IBM Plex Mono
Live page is older than local: live lacks @graph JSON-LD, robots/sitemap/llms/404 at the site path
No user research or analytics; conversion findings are friction observations, not measured drop-off

evidence.observation: Captured 2026-11-16T00:05:42Z; live page 200; site-path robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt and 404.html return 404 on live (not deployed yet, exist locally); privacy/support 200
Both App Store elements are Coming soon to the App Store, not links or buttons; the only other hero action is a.btn2 to #how; no share, copy-link, notify or bookmark action anywhere on the page
span.soon renders as a dark filled pill with an Apple logo, the largest action-shaped element in the hero on both widths, styled like the white button beside it; final section repeats it
evidence.limitations: Static images; tap behaviour not observed by a user

evidence.limitations: No user test of mobile navigation

evidence.source: local assets/ (ls -la); index.html:58, 125; CDP resource list

evidence.method: JSON-LD parse (python json.loads OK) + content comparison
evidence.observation: Local @graph = VideoGame+MobileApplication, WebSite, FAQPage, all parse. Game node has offers {price 0, USD, availability https://schema.org/PreOrder} while the visible page says only 'Coming soon' and the FAQ says 'This page will link to it on launch day' (no pre-order exists). FAQ answers match visible <details> text. Live still serves an older single VideoGame node with applicationCategory "Game"
evidence.limitations: No external validator run; rich-result eligibility not tested

evidence.observation: Valid llms.txt shape (H1, blockquote summary, fact bullets, ## Pages with 3 absolute links to live 200 pages). Line 3 says 'Thawscope (on the App Store as "Thawscope: Word Puzzle") ... Coming soon to the App Store.'
evidence.limitations: Listing name not verifiable; no App Store record checked

evidence.observation: /thawscope-site/llms.txt is 404 on live; the origin https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/llms.txt contains no 'thawscope' entry
evidence.limitations: Capture-time; deploy is pending by design

evidence.source: local support.html:22-53, privacy.html:22-40, 404.html:62-80; head.local.json vs head.json
evidence.observation: Sub-pages reuse the same tokens (#F3F5F7, #24282C, #5E656C, #B84300) and system-ui; 404 adds the thermal ramp and root-absolute links (/thawscope-site/), noindex. Local differs from live only in head metadata, JSON-LD and footer owner name

coverage.rationale: Palette, ramp and tone are consistent across home, support, privacy and 404 (E3, E14); the two declared brand typefaces are never loaded, so rendered type depends on the OS (F8)

No horizontal scroll at 320-768, layout stacks cleanly in the 390 screenshot (E3, E5); header nav disappears at 820px and below with no substitute (F3). Third screenshot hidden at 421-820px is a deliberate grid choice, noted not filed. Orientation, zoom/reflow at 400% not tested

Sampled checks pass: landmarks, heading order, skip link, visible focus on every stop, AA contrast for all text tokens, no motion (E6, E7). One text alternative describes content the image does not show (F2). Screen reader and iOS VoiceOver not tested
Lab run is fast: LCP <=152 ms, CLS 0, about 56 KB at mobile widths (E5). One oversized header image (F4). No field data; unthrottled lab only

Value and FAQ answer the main objections (free, offline, no data). The primary goal, remembering the game for launch, has no action: both App Store elements are inert spans styled as buttons and there is no share/copy/notify path (F1)

Local JSON-LD parses and FAQ text matches visible content; offers.availability PreOrder claims a pre-order that does not exist (F5). Live still has the older node until deploy. FAQ rich results are limited by Google to authoritative government/health sites, so FAQPage is for parsers, not an expected rich result

Local file is well formed with accurate, curated links (E12) but states a present App Store listing (F6) and is not yet live nor listed at the origin (F7). llms.txt is a proposal; no provider adoption claimed

No copy-link or share action exists; for this page a share/copy-link action directly serves the remember-for-launch goal, so it is filed with F1. Open-in-AI buttons are optional and not recommended here

findings.title: No way to save or share the game for launch; the button-styled 'Coming soon' pill is an inert span
findings.recommendation: Next to span.soon in the hero and the final section, add a button reusing the existing .btn2 style labelled 'Share Thawscope' that calls navigator.share({title, url: canonical}) and falls back to navigator.clipboard.writeText(canonical) with a visible 'Link copied' message in an aria-live region. On launch (or when an App Store pre-order exists) turn span.soon into an <a> to the App Store URL with the same classes and add <meta name="apple-itunes-app" content="app-id=…">. No new colours or type.

findings.title: won.webp alt text and caption describe a stars result sheet the image does not show (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.1.1)
findings.recommendation: Change the alt to describe what is shown, e.g. 'A won level: the frozen word HONEY fully thawed, best probe 100°, with 20 of 30 probes left.' and the caption to 'Thawed: the word named with probes to spare.' Or replace the image with a capture that shows the stars sheet and keep the current text.

findings.title: Header navigation is hidden at 820px and below with no replacement
findings.recommendation: Remove `header.top nav { display: none; }` from the 820px query and instead hide only the 'How it plays' link below about 420px (the hero already has 'See how it plays'), keeping FAQ and Support visible in the same ink2 link style. Layout-only change, no palette or type change.

findings.title: Header icon ships a 25.5 KB 256px PNG into a 40px slot
findings.recommendation: Export the same icon at 80px and 120px (WebP or optimised PNG) and use . Pixels are identical at display size.

findings.title: JSON-LD Offer says PreOrder although no pre-order or store link exists
findings.recommendation: Drop the `offers` object (or at least its `availability`) until the App Store listing exists; at launch add offers {price "0", priceCurrency "USD", availability InStock, url <App Store URL>} plus `sameAs` to the listing. Do not add ratings or reviews that do not exist.

findings.title: llms.txt states a present App Store listing name while the game is unreleased
findings.recommendation: Reword line 3 to 'Thawscope (to be listed on the App Store as "Thawscope: Word Puzzle") ... Coming soon to the App Store; no store link yet.' and switch to the real listing URL on launch day.

findings.title: llms.txt is not live yet and the origin llms.txt does not list Thawscope
findings.recommendation: Deploy the local s9-site branch to Pages, then add one Thawscope entry linking https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/thawscope-site/llms.txt in the root nguyenvanlamm.github.io llms.txt.

findings.title: Declared brand typefaces (Instrument Sans, IBM Plex Mono) are never loaded, so type falls back to each OS
findings.recommendation: Restyle — needs owner. Either self-host subset WOFF2 files for both families with @font-face and font-display: swap (the look then changes on every device to the intended fonts), or remove the two names from the stacks so the CSS documents the system-font look that actually ships. Owner decides which look is the approved one.

plan.title: Run a VoiceOver pass on iPhone Safari over home, support and privacy
plan.expected_impact: Closes the screen-reader evidence gap before launch
acceptance_checks: VoiceOver reads skip link, nav, h1, the Coming soon text, FAQ disclosure states and every image alt in order, with notes recorded per page

plan.title: Add a share/copy-link action now and link the App Store at launch
plan.expected_impact: Gives visitors a concrete way to keep the game for launch; verify by observing share/copy use if analytics are ever added (none today)
acceptance_checks: On iPhone Safari the button opens the share sheet with the canonical URL; on desktop Chrome it copies the URL and announces 'Link copied' via aria-live
Button uses existing .btn2 styles; diff touches no colour or font values
At launch, both .soon elements are <a> to the App Store URL and keyboard-focusable

plan.title: Make won.webp alt and caption match the image
plan.expected_impact: Screen-reader and sighted users get an accurate description
acceptance_checks: Alt and caption mention only elements visible in assets/won.webp (no stars or result sheet unless the image is replaced with one that shows them)

plan.title: Keep FAQ and Support links visible in the mobile header
plan.expected_impact: Mobile visitors can jump to FAQ/Support without scrolling the whole page
acceptance_checks: At 320, 375, 390 and 768 px the header shows FAQ and Support with no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth == innerWidth)

plan.title: Serve a right-sized header icon
plan.expected_impact: Removes about 20 KB from the first view on mobile; no timing claim
acceptance_checks: Header icon transfer is under 6 KB in a cache-disabled DevTools load at 390 px and looks identical at 2x and 3x

plan.title: Align JSON-LD offers with the real availability
plan.expected_impact: Markup no longer claims a pre-order that visitors cannot find
acceptance_checks: JSON-LD still parses (json.loads) and contains no PreOrder availability while no store link exists
Schema.org validator shows no errors for the @graph

plan.title: Reword the llms.txt store claim to future tense
plan.expected_impact: Assistants do not tell users to search the App Store before launch
acceptance_checks: llms.txt line 3 says the listing is upcoming and matches the page's 'Coming soon' wording

plan.title: Deploy the site branch and list it in the root llms.txt
plan.expected_impact: llms.txt and the new JSON-LD become reachable on the live site
acceptance_checks: GET https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/thawscope-site/llms.txt returns 200 with the reworded text

plan.title: Owner decision: load the brand fonts or drop them from the CSS
plan.expected_impact: Rendered type matches the approved design on every device
acceptance_checks: Owner confirms which look is approved; if fonts load, DevTools shows both families with status loaded and CLS stays 0; if dropped, no unloaded family names remain in index.html
